page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1.4xlarge is a memory-optimized instance powered by the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. It features 16 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, providing 16 vCPUs. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps under the KVM hypervisor.

Benchmark data indicates a clear contrast between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core processing is relatively weak, with stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25% and 10% respectively. However, multi-core execution scales to average levels, as demonstrated by average ratings in multi-core stress-ng, Geekbench, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. Memory bandwidth tests show average read and write speeds, though the Passmark memory score is positioned in the lower 25%.

Given its high memory density relative to compute resources, this instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive workloads that do not require top-tier single-thread performance. It is well-suited for medium-sized databases, caching layers like Redis, static web serving, and memory-heavy enterprise applications.
